robloxBadges.name: Homestead
robloxBadges.description: This badge was earned by having your personal place visited 100 times. People who achieved this have demonstrated their ability to build cool things that other Robloxians were interested enough in to check out. This badge could be earned from 2007 to 2026. It has been retired and is no longer attainable.

robloxBadges.name: Bricksmith
robloxBadges.description: This badge was earned by having a popular personal place. Once your place had been visited 1000 times, you received this award. Robloxians with Bricksmith badges are accomplished builders who were able to create a place that people wanted to explore a thousand times. They no doubt know a thing or two about putting bricks together. This badge could be earned from 2007 to 2026. It has been retired and is no longer attainable.

robloxBadges.name: Friendship
robloxBadges.description: This badge was given to members who embraced the Roblox community and made at least 20 friends. People who have this badge are good people to know and can probably help you out if you are having trouble. This badge could be earned from 2007 to 2026. It has been retired and is no longer attainable.

userGames.name: ANGEL or DEMON
userGames.description:
😇 Angel or Demon Quiz? 😈
Are you a pure soul or a mischievous rebel? It’s time to find out in the ultimate Angel vs Demon Quiz! Answer 20 unique questions about your personality, your choices, and your secrets to reveal your true nature. Will you fly with the angels or rule with the demons? ⚖️

✨ HOW TO PLAY
📝 Take the Quiz: Answer honest questions about how you treat others and how you see the world.

📊 Get your Result: Discover if you are an Angel, a Demon, or perfectly Balanced.

🎭 Transform: Your character automatically receives exclusive wings and items based on your result!

📖 Learn More: Read your full personality analysis to understand your strengths and weaknesses.

💎 FEATURES
😇 Angel Side: Unlock beautiful glowing wings and peaceful tools.

😈 Demon Side: Unlock dark wings, horns, and mischievous items.

⚖️ Balanced: For those who master both light and shadow!

📈 Global Stats: See how many players are Angels vs Demons in real-time on the global leaderboard!

userGames.name: Salle Ancienne Rush
userGames.description:
Entrez dans un monde de mystère et de hasard! Dans RNG Door Adventure, chaque porte que vous ouvrez mène à une pièce unique de rareté variable. Testez votre chance en découvrant des pièces rares, en suivant vos progrès sur le tableau de bord et en rivalisant avec des amis pour découvrir les trésors les plus rares. Chaque joueur apparaît dans sa propre salle de départ pour une aventure personnalisée!

Caractéristiques:

Chambres générées aléatoirement avec différentes raretés.
Un tableau de bord pour suivre votre progression et afficher la pièce la plus rare que vous ayez trouvée.
Options de passe de jeu pour améliorer votre expérience, y compris le double de vitesse et une augmentation de la chance.
Génère un départ unique pour chaque joueur pour garantir une expérience fraîche.
Trouverez-vous la pièce la plus rare? Commencez votre aventure maintenant et laissez la chance guider votre voyage!

35726151.name: Room Rush
35726151.description:
Room Rush is a game where you have to open doors to discover rooms of various rarities. You can sell them or simply display them in the spawn after equipping them in your inventory.

⚠️ Donations are made through the sale of clothing and game passes, which can take up to one week to process. The Robux shown in the game reflect the price at the time of sale. The Robux you receive may be lower due to Roblox fees.
View your pending Robux here: https://www.roblox.com/transactions

Game Development: @HyperDev7 (Roblox)  
Scripter: @mykinglisa (Roblox)  
VFX Artist: @BlueShotss (Roblox)
